decisive_spans.text: MRI revealed a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body, hypointense on T1, isointense on T2 FLAIR

response.rationale: D4 is strongly supported by imaging findings consistent with CNS lymphoma, including a homogeneous mass with rim enhancement and vasogenic edema. D1 has some general support but lacks specific imaging findings to differentiate it from other conditions.
